SP Flash Tool GUI dong obi yabo ki firmware ni ma ki keto con.

• I SP Flash Tool, yer "Format All + Download" ki i bok ma ki keto piny.
• Dii bute ma waco ni "Kwany".
• Nen ni {jami} ni tye ki mac ma otum ki ki kwanyo.
{hint}
• Med waya me USB i komputa ni ingee dii me kwanyo.

Dii OK me yabo SP Flash Tool ki aa ki i Updater CE.

donate_intro_success_mediatek:
Wa keto {software} i kom {model} ni.

Hey! An aye Ryan, layub ma tye i nge MediaTek Installer. Aculo wel cente me gwoko ki gwoko jami ki i cinga me gwoko jami ma ki keto ni nono ki oyabe. Ka okonyo in, tim ber itam i kom miiyo kony — man gwoko yub ni bedo kwo pi dano weny.

donate_intro_success:
Wa keto {software} i kom {model} ni.

Hey! An aye Ryan, layub ma tye i nge Updater CE, Community Firmware Archive, ki Themes Gallery. Aculo ~$200 me dwe ki dwe ki wel cente me gwoko jami ki i cinga me gwoko jami weng nono ki oyabe. Ka gin ni okonyi, tim ber itam i kom miiyo kony — en gwoko jami eni makwo pi dano weny.
donate_intro_general: Jal! An aye Ryan, layub ma tye i nge Updater CE, Community Firmware Archive, ki Themes Gallery. Aculo pi gwoko jami ma ki keto i cim, gwoko jami ma ki gwoko, ki dwoko rwom me tic ki cente na me gwoko jami weng labongo culu. Gwoko ne dwe ki dwe bino i wel ma romo $200 — kony mo keken ma imiyo konyo me gwoko jami tic magi makwo pi won jami mukene.

themepack_step1_title: Tyelo 1: Kub i kit me gwoko USB
themepack_step1_desc:
1. Yab gin ma tuku ni kun imako bute ma ki lwongo ni Power.
2. Ka Rockbox oyabe, ket waya me USB i komputa ni.
3. Ka ki penyo i kom gin ma ki lwongo ni player, moko USB Storage mode wek gin ni onen calo drive.
themepack_step2_title: Tyelo me 2: Yer ka gwoko gin mo kiken ma tye i kom gin ma tuku ni
themepack_step2_desc: Pien jami ma tiiyo kwede (ma calo macOS) kano dotfiles (ma calo .rockbox) kit ma ki keto kwede, ki in itwero yero folda mo keken onyo gin ma ki lwongo ni drive root i kom player ni. Wabi nongo onyo yubu .rockbox directory piri.
themepack_btn_select_folder: Yer ka gwoko ne i kom latuku...
themepack_status_extracting: Keto jami ma ki keto i .rockbox...
themepack_complete: Gin ma ki keto i yub ni ki keto maber! Iromo kwanyo gin ma ki lwongo ni player ni ki iyero gin mo i Rockbox (Settings > Theme Settings).
themepack_err_not_found: Pe kitwero nongo onyo yabo .rockbox directory i kom gin ma ki yero ni. Nen ni iyero folda mo i kom gin ma itye ka tuko kwede.
rockbox_wizard_skip_adb: Wot i kit me gwoko USB
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Tyelo 1: Yab gin ma tuku ni odoco ki dok i lok
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Kwanyo waya me USB ni.
2. Med teko i kom gin ma tuku ni ki wek ocak donyo i Rockbox.
3. Ka Rockbox dong tye ka tic, dwoko USB cable ni, ki dong dii Continue.
rockbox_wizard_adb_title: Tyelo me 2: Yenyo latuku ma kato ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App ni tye ka neno pi rwate pa ADB (ma oo i ceken 30). Ka gin mo ki nongo, gin ma ki lwongo ni themes ki loko ki latuku ni obi cako tic kene. Ka kumeno ku, cito anyim i USB Storage Mode.
rockbox_wizard_adb_searching: Tye ka kuro gin ma ki lwongo ni ADB... (ma romo ceken 30)
rockbox_wizard_adb_found: Gin ma ki nongo ({serial}); loko wi lok...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Pe ki nongo gin mo kiken ma ki lwongo ni ADB i kin ceken 30; medo ki kit me gwoko USB.
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Pe tye ADB binary ma tye i app ni; medo ki kit me gwoko USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Keto wi lok ki coc i kom ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: ADB ma ki cwalo ni obale; dwogo cen i kit me gwoko USB
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Yab USB Storage Mode i kom gin ma tuku ni wek onen calo gin ma ki lwongo ni drive.
2. Yer folda mo keken i kom gin ma ki lwongo ni player ma piny kany (.rockbox, Music, Themes, onyo gin ma ki lwongo ni drive root — folda ma ki kano ma ki lwongo ni .rockbox nonge kene).
3. App ni medo 360p themes ki fonts, kun coyo nying acel.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Iromo kwanyo gin ma tuku ni labongo ayella ki iyero gin mo ki i Rockbox (Kabedo > Kit me keto gin ni).
legacy_cleanup_desc: Gin macon me Updater pud tye i komputa ni ki kwanyo kabedo i disk. Kwanyo ne weko kabedo ni bedo agonya.
